svg.title: Stu (@stu-titor). Systems and machine learning. So far that has meant a pipelined CPU and cache simulator, a malloc with binned free lists, a Huffman compressor, and a CNN trained from scratch on Tiny ImageNet. A punched FORTRAN card reading: PRINT *, "HELLO, I'M STU. I BUILD THINGS FROM THE BOTTOM UP."
